# 60-second primer

We are scoping **Paper 2** (the follow-up to the NeurIPS submission).

- Paper 1 = manual SimAdapter recipe on one elaborate scientific tool
  (GEOS). See `docs/2026-05-02_neurips-paper-plan.md` §11 for the
  Paper-1/Paper-2 scope split.
- Paper 2 = **automatically discover the adapter** given the tool's
  documentation. Framed as a meta-harness procedure where **both the
  meta-harness and the harness it builds ground in the same docs**.

Closest baselines:

- Meta-Harness (Lee et al. 2026) — flat FS, free-form coding agent.
- MCE (Ye et al. 2026) — agentic skill recombination.
- AHE (Lin et al. 2026) — observability + falsifiable edits.
- **SkillFoundry (Shen et al. 2026)** — newly read on 2026-05-14;
  staged GPT-5.4 pipeline with JSON-schema responses, capability
  tree, breadth-first.

White-space identified: **none of the four treats documentation as
*structured substrate the meta-harness reasons over*.** MoSciBench
(Liu et al. 2026) is a warning shot — naïve "add domain knowledge"
hurts (48.4 → 44.9); structure has to do real work.

Recommended Paper-2 core (full reasoning in the design memo below):

- **N1** — typed document index (schema / example / tutorial / warning)
- **N2** — bipartite component↔section graph (adds *grounding* as a
  4th observability pillar to AHE's three)
- **N3** — doc-anchored failure attribution (3-way classification;
  attacks AHE's near-random regression prediction)
- **N5** — documentation as soft test oracle (4th validation layer
  beyond SkillFoundry's exec/system/synthetic)

# Suggested overnight tasks (pick from the design memo §8)

In rough priority order:

1. **Clone SkillFoundry**
   (`https://github.com/ma-compbio-lab/SkillFoundry`). Read the real
   prompts + JSON schemas. Confirm whether `resource_search` ever
   parses doc structure or just treats doc pages as plain text. This
   is the single most informative thing for our novelty claim.
2. **Probe target tool docs** (GEOS / FEniCS / MOOSE). Which has the
   cleanest schema / tutorial / reference / warning typing? Answer
   determines feasibility of N1 (typed multi-index).
3. **Read AHE's "Agent Debugger" implementation** — closest prior art
   to a doc-grounded attribution layer. Repo:
   `china-qijizhifeng/agentic-harness-engineering`.
4. **Run `/adversarial-review`** on the design memo. It has not been
   reviewed yet.

# Don'ts for the overnight session

- **Don't dispatch `literature-scout`** for paper reading.
  Stored-feedback preference: fetch PDFs and clone repos directly.
- **Don't re-summarize the four papers**. The notes are written; if
  something needs refining, edit in place rather than producing a
  fifth restatement.
- **Don't expand N1–N9 into nine separate prototype implementations**.
  The recommended core is four; pick from those.
